title: A redesigned Polytechnic Study Hub app is available
message: Update for a polished launch screen, native app bar and faster access to every study section.
releaseNotes: Attractive branded opening screen instead of a blank white screen.
Native top app bar with menu and refresh controls.
Slide-out navigation for lessons, materials, syllabus and question papers.
Active menu highlighting and improved loading feedback.
All v1.0.1 security fixes remain enabled.
